sectionHeader.title: How seasoned production heads evaluate working with us
sectionHeader.lede: Our buyers do not purchase promises. They manage balance sheets, critical paths, and retail floor delivery deadlines. Here is why they stay.

testimonials.quote: The open cost sheets are the fundamental difference. We can see exactly what we're paying for raw greige cotton, CMT labor and shipping margin. A price change never comes as an unpleasant ambush mid-season because every variable is indexed.
testimonials.impact: Zero mid-season price disputes across 4 years

testimonials.quote: We moved our denim program to Attire Services after chronic shade-variation and lot rejections with our previous agency. In two years and eighteen 40-foot containers, we haven't had a single lot fail our warehouse QC in Rotterdam.

Having one contract and a single accountable principal for factory floor QC, bill of lading, and UK customs clearance — rather than wrangling three separate brokers — eliminated weeks of friction from our launch cycle.
testimonials.impact: 3.5 weeks shaved from first fit to UK dock
